nombre_oficial: el glosario pide "Toltec" para "Tolteca / Toltecas" y no aparece

frase_gancho.texto: Warriors of stone and artisans whom the Mexica remembered as the great masters.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: After the fall of Teotihuacán, central Mexico reorganized itself around cities with a warlike character. Out of that world rose Tula, the Toltec capital. In Nahuatl, Toltec means artisan or wise person, and the Mexica remembered the Toltecs as the masters of all the arts. Here you will see the Atlantean figures, warriors of stone that held up the roof of a temple. There is also a Chac Mool, a wall of serpents, and pieces made with shell, turquoise, and fine ceramic. The Toltec style reached as far as Yucatán, and the Mexica took it as a model of prestige.
